messages:
Priya K: Hi finance — spotted an odd charge on my corporate card from the Tokyo hotel. It's listed as a 5% 'EMT SURCHARGE' and the folio doesn't show the room upgrade I had approval for. Do we dispute or just file reimbursement? I have screenshots of the charge and the DM approval from @Ava R.
Sam T: Can you paste the txn details and the reservation #? If you already have approval, that helps — otherwise we need the approval thread or travel form.
Priya K: Here are the details:
```
Charge: JPY 18,250
Post date: 2026-11-03
Merchant: HOTEL TOKYO SHINBASHI
Auth code: 7A9XQ
Descriptor: HOTELTOKYO*EMT SURCHARGE
Converted: $128.73 (card provider rate)
```
Priya K: I have the DM approval screenshot from Ava — will attach. The folio only shows room + tax, no line for "EMT" surcharge.
Liam F: If the surcharge is just a hotel fee for card usage, Finance normally treats it as part of lodging if pre-approved. We do NOT cover bank DCC (dynamic conversion) markups. Need itemized folio to see if surcharge came from merchant or card network.
Expenses Bot: FYI — upload receipts and itemized folio under expense category `travel/tokyo`. Missing folio will prevent auto-approval.
Ava R: Confirmed — I okayed the upgrade in the thread "Tokyo conf — room upgrade ok" on 2026-10-29. Priya, please attach that DM as proof.
Priya K: Quick Q: if folio doesn't show surcharge, should I start a dispute with the card provider now or submit the expense with a note?
Sam T: Submit the expense first with the folio + approval screenshot and put a note: "contains EMT surcharge — please review for bank dispute if merchant fee unlisted." We can escalate to bank for chargeback if merchant misrepresented.
Liam F: Also ask the card provider if DCC was applied at point-of-sale. If they forced conversion, sometimes bank can reverse the markup. Bank disputes take 2–6 weeks.
Priya K: Got it — filing now and uploading: receipt screenshot, folio PDF (missing surcharge line), approval DM screenshot. Tagging @Expenses Bot for tracking.
Expenses Bot: Expense EXP-3248 created and assigned to Finance Ops. Status: pending manual review.
Priya K: Thanks everyone :thumbsup: I added a short note in the expense about potential DCC and attached all proofs.
Sam T: We'll follow up on the chargeback if Finance Ops flags it. If you see any other weird merchant descriptors, ping me directly.
Priya K: Will do, appreciate the quick help.
